attempt_history.llm_sketch:
The workflow validates. Here is the final YAML:

workflow_id: wf_btp_002
steps:
  - id: receive_document
    op: fetch_api
    params:
      endpoint: "/documents/upload/pending"
      method: GET
    output: document_payload

  - id: authenticate_indexing_service
    op: authenticate_user
    params:
      service: indexing_service
      method: service_account
    output: auth_token

  - id: validate_anonymization
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: "{{document_payload}}"
      rules:
        - check: pii_anonymized
          expected: true
        - check: pii_fields_present
          expected: false
    output: anonymization_result

  - id: terminate_if_not_anonymized
    op: route_to_step
    params:
      condition: "{{anonymization_result.valid}} == false"
      target: handle_pii_error

  - id: chunk_document
    op: transform_json
    params:
      input: "{{document_payload.text}}"
      strategy: overlapping_chunks
      chunk_size: 512
      chunk_overlap: 64
      source_document_id: "{{document_payload.document_id}}"
    output: chunks

  - id: generate_embeddings
    op: loop_records
    params:
      collection: "{{chunks}}"
      operation:
        op: fetch_api
        params:
          endpoint: "/embeddings/generate"
          method: POST
          body:
            text: "{{item.text}}"
            model: embedding_model
            source_document_id: "{{document_payload.document_id}}"
            chunk_index: "{{item.index}}"
    output: embedded_chunks

  - id: store_embeddings
    op: write_database
    params:
      target: vector_database
      collection: document_embeddings
      data: "{{embedded_chunks}}"
      metadata:
        source_document_id: "{{document_payload.document_id}}"
        chunk_count: "{{embedded_chunks.length}}"
    output: storage_result

  - id: log_indexing_complete
    op: log_audit
    params:
      action: document_indexed
      document_id: "{{document_payload.document_id}}"
      chunks_stored: "{{embedded_chunks.length}}"
      status: success

  - id: handle_pii_error
    op: handle_error
    params:
      error_type: pii_not_anonymized
      message: "Document {{document_payload.document_id}} contains PII and cannot be indexed"
      severity: critical

  - id: terminate_on_pii
    op: terminate_workflow
    params:
      reason: "Document not anonymized — PII must not reach the vector store"
